channel.title: Japan AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of Japan's political, economic and security developments

item.title: Producer price growth cools, easing urgency for further Bank of Japan hikes
item.description: The measure of input prices climbed 6.8% in September from a year earlier, slowing from 7.6% in the previous month, according to the Bank of Japan.

item.title: Katayama to be first Japanese chair of IMF-World Bank development panel
item.description: The committee, established in 1974, is currently chaired by Swedish Finance Minister Elisabeth Svantesson.

item.title: DC United’s Japanese connection grows with Kijima at its heart
item.description: Kijima is part of a trio of Japanese players on the DC United team.

item.title: French defense firm Thales to build Japan base, media report says
item.description: Thales Chairman and CEO Patrice Caine told the Nikkei daily that the base "will mark a milestone toward Thales's long-term engagement in Japan."

item.title: Swiss franc, Japanese yen Rise as DeepSeek News Boosts Safe Havens
item.description: The Yen and Swiss Franc were stronger against the dollar as investors sought safe havens after Chinese start-up DeepSeek’s new AI model hit U.S. tech stocks.
